test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __asleep in and__ missed the bus!
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**asleep**."
 
• The correct verb form should be "**slept**" to match the past tense context of the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**slept in and**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"I slept in__ and missed the bus!"***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "sleeps in and"** – The verb form "sleeps" is incorrect for the subject "I" and does not match the past tense context.
 
• **Option 3: "No improvement"** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• **Option 4: "sleep in or"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence and does not correct the verb form issued.
